honestLimits: Refunds remain fake-provider only until P5 wires a real provider refund; the RPC rejects other providers and the UI offers the action only for fake payments.
A refund writes the audit trail but does not notify the traveller or creator; messaging depends on the open cancellation policy decision.
The payment list shows the latest 100 rows (hasMore returned, no cursor UI) and the provider ledger the latest 50; pagination is needed before real volume.
The dashboard is request/refresh driven with no live subscription, and signature-failure attempts are deliberately not persisted.
Payout accrual, receipts and invoices remain unimplemented; payout tables are schema-only until the owner's payout decisions.
